name: mindflow-mental-health-platform
description: MindFlow Vue 3 frontend and Flask API launcher

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "python -m flask --app entry.app run --port 5000" "vite --config frontend/vite.config.js --configLoader runner"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:server
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run start:server
